{{Quote|Nerfalicious. All you space slugs wandering around in a haze and wondering what's going on. I'll TELL YOU WHAT'S GOING ON. You're going to die. If I was one of those half-speaking brainless gunga-types, I'd say there's a "bombad war" coming. Thing is, you know who gets killed in war? Dumb people. So go on, go out and fight, be dumb, and come back in a box.|l@2erbr@1n, in a post on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
The handle '''l@2erbr@1n''' was used by an individual as a user ID on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], there was widespread discussion on a Cularin holonet node forum regarding evidence shared by the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] of a purported [[Thaereian military]] plot to destabilize the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. In response, l@2erbr@1n posted on the forum to criticize other users that had discussed the [[Thaereian]] scheme and warned that the Thaereian military planned a war in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="destabilization" />
